title: CA-RAG: Constraint-Aligned Retrieval for Structurally Faithful Long-Form Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.33497v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) typically optimises evidence selection for semantic relevance, whereas compliance-sensitive long-form generation also requires evidence supporting explicit structural obligations. Semantically relevant retrieval may therefore omit information needed for mandatory downstream clauses. We propose Constraint-Aligned RAG (CA-RAG), a retrieval-conditioning framework that augments section-specific queries with ontology-derived structural constraints and policy-grounded knowledge-graph relations before evidence selection. Retrieval-only evaluation with manually annotated evidence shows consistent improvements across retrieval budgets. At $k=6$, CA-RAG increases Precision@$k$ from $0.5268$ to $0.5692$, pooled Recall@$k$ from $0.5402$ to $0.5950$, and F1@$k$ from $0.5389$ to $0.5672$ over standard RAG. translated_title: CA-RAG：面向结构忠实长文本生成的约束对齐检索
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）通常针对语义相关性来优化证据选择，而对合规敏感的长文本生成还需要能够支持明确结构性义务的证据。因此，仅基于语义相关的检索可能遗漏下游强制性条款所需的信息。我们提出了约束对齐检索增强生成（CA-RAG），这是一种检索条件化框架，在证据选择之前，利用源自本体的结构约束和基于政策的知识图谱关系来增强针对特定章节的查询。在人工标注证据上的纯检索评估显示，该方法在各种检索预算下均取得一致的性能提升。在 k=6 时，与标准 RAG 相比，CA-RAG 将 Precision@k 从 0.5268 提升至 0.5692，将综合 Recall@k 从 0.5402 提升至 0.5950，将 F1@k 从 0.5389 提升至 0.5672。生成实验进一步表明，在多个模型-领域设置中，生成内容的合规性和可靠性均有提升。
tldr: 提出 CA-RAG 框架，在证据检索前利用本体结构约束和基于政策的知识图谱关系增强章节级查询，显著提升合规敏感长文本生成中证据检索的精确率、召回率和生成合规性。
en_tdlr: CA-RAG conditions retrieval by augmenting section-specific queries with ontology-derived structural constraints and policy-grounded knowledge-graph relations, improving evidence precision, recall, and generation compliance for structurally faithful long-form generation.
